dataset: 令和2年国勢調査に関する地域メッシュ統計・250m人口総数
statistic: 通常の居住地による人口総数。人口のモデル推計値や都市別の架空重みではない。
distributionPublisher: 国土地理院・地理院地図
sourceFormat: PMTiles v3 containing uncompressed Mapbox Vector Tiles; layer population; numeric population property; EPSG:3857 tile coordinates
sourceResolution: 250m JIS regional mesh, latitude 1/480 degree and longitude 1/320 degree
sourceDatumNote: Source GeoJSON coordinates are geographic longitude/latitude; the PMTiles mirror stores Web Mercator tile coordinates. The mirror does not identify whether the original census tabulation datum is JGD2000 or JGD2011, so no unsupported original EPSG datum is claimed. The derived grid recovers the JIS cells from geographic coordinates.
deduplication: Decode only zoom 10. Convert each point to geographic coordinates. Key by floor(latitude*480), floor(longitude*320); retain one identical population value per 250m cell. Reject conflicting values. Zooms below 10 contain clusters and must not be used.

grid.resolution: 5km JIS mesh approximation; latitude 1/24 degree by longitude 1/16 degree
grid.rowConvention: iy=0 is the southern row; ix=0 is the western column

processing: Reconstruct and deduplicate 250m census cells, sum each 20x20 block to the aligned 5km grid, and retain all Japanese populated cells including Minamitorishima. No interpolation, modeled counts, or hand-adjusted city weights.
license: e-Stat content terms of use, compatible with CC BY 4.0; GSI content terms apply to the source distribution. Reuse and redistribution with source and processing attribution.
attribution: 「令和2年国勢調査に関する地域メッシュ統計」（総務省統計局、地理院地図で提供）を加工して作成。250mメッシュを重複除去し、約5kmメッシュに集計。取得ミラー：mghs15/population-mesh-via-gsimaps。

reproduction.rawDataPolicy: Keep the 25MB raw PMTiles and temporary Python dependencies in ignored work/; do not commit them.
